what_this_is: The tests already failing on each repository's pristine snapshot. Regression acceptance means no failure outside this set; a new one is a regression and one of these is the snapshot.
why_it_is_frozen_rather_than_recomputed: Recomputing per episode would let a flaky test join the baseline the first time it failed, which is the same as having no baseline.
why_it_is_needed: The frozen population records the command and the test total and nothing about the baseline's own failures. Scored by exit code, every agent-operator-score episode fails regression whatever the agent does, which would zero that repository in an equal-weight estimand and make section 27's AOS condition unreachable.
